craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta-vīra of the Lord's array, limb by limb — weapon-and-ensign song. Thread-loosed sapless; as-it-were kept (twice — showing, not being). Rejected: (a) cutting as-it-were → killed: as-if is the showing-mode. Read aloud: KNOW-ing-THREAD-loosed … TO-us, LORD.

lines: sense-skull-garlanded You show — as it were — to us, Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: saṃvitsūtranilīno niḥsāro mātṛnivaho 'yam | karaṇamuṇḍamālabhārin darśayasītīva naḥ svāmin

reads_against.argmap: What thread dissolves the knower-host? → Thread-dissolved sapless shown skull-garlanded as-if to us.
c1_essence: Borne pointed; opposed unopposed in me.
Impassioned cloth cast; bloodied hide told.
Dagger bared splitting; taken-world heroes best.
Noosed time counted; death's death shown.
Hurled to unmake; goad makes plain.
Bow shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer deer-pierced.
